description: Receive peer messages. Returns immediately by default (wait=0); pass wait up to 120 to long-poll. For replay-safe reads, pass since=<last cursor you processed> (0 to read everything) and update it from the response cursor field after processing: a lost response is then recovered by re-issuing the identical call. Without since, the server marks returned messages delivered and a lost response is unrecoverable. Set self=true to include your own messages (full transcript replay). Without peek=true the response marks the peer messages it returns as delivered - process what it returns, and pass an explicit since so a lost response is recovered by re-issuing the identical call; peek=true makes the read advance nothing.

peek.description: Read-only: advance no delivery cursor (use for send verification)

name: acq_recv
